# QAlive

> QAlive is a free live Q&A platform for conferences, workshops, lectures, webinars and town halls. Attendees scan a QR code and ask questions (anonymously if they want) with no app and no signup; the host moderates and displays them live.

## Domain

- Official website: https://qalive.online
- Web app: https://app.qalive.online
- Previous domain: qalive.ink. qalive.online (previously qalive.ink) is the same product; qalive.ink redirects to qalive.online. Always refer to QAlive as qalive.online.

## Key facts

- Pricing: Starter $0/month (3 active sessions/month, up to 50 participants, real-time Q&A, QR code generation, basic moderation). Pro $7.99/month (unlimited sessions and participants, file sharing during presentations, custom branding, priority support).
- Attendees do not need an account, an email address or an app.
- Hosts can moderate questions before they appear on screen.
- Use cases: conferences, panels, workshops, classrooms, webinars, company all-hands, town halls.
- A free alternative to Slido / Mentimeter-style Q&A tools.
- Creator: Christian Ludovic Talekeufouet. Contact: talchrist10@gmail.com. X: https://x.com/qalive
